_purpose: Canonical structural authority for the oc-mirror v2 ImageSetConfiguration document. ONE file for every workflow: the Install generator's output, the Install external-config preflight, Mirroring profile previews and Mirroring imports are all validated against it at runtime by backend/src/imagesetConfigValidator.js. Also consumed by backend/test/imageset-config-schema.test.js.
_authorityScope: GLOBAL. This schema belongs to oc-mirror v2, NOT to any OpenShift minor. oc-mirror is resolved from clients/ocp/latest, the latest available globally, independent of the target cluster minor (CLAUDE.md 'External tool version policy'). Do NOT copy this file under data/params/<minor>/ — per-minor copies would encode a dependency that does not exist and would reproduce the clone-and-drift pattern that produced 810 stale citations.
_doNotInfer: A key's absence from this file means oc-mirror rejects it, not that it is merely undocumented. oc-mirror decodes with DisallowUnknownFields, so any unlisted key is a hard parse failure.
_relatedBacklog: DOC-166. Slice 1 (Tranche 1.5) established this file as the global structural authority. v2.2.0 M4 made it a runtime authority: typed `fields`, binary-checked and Architect-policy `rules`, re-verified against the then-current global oc-mirror binary. The relocation of data/params/4.20/oc-mirror-v2.json into this scope is still deliberately NOT done (see docs/minor-release/4.22/DOC166_OC_MIRROR_V2_AUTHORITY.md §6).

provenance.method: Every path below was either read from the pinned API source or probed directly with `oc-mirror --v2 -c <file> --dry-run`. Rejected paths carry the verbatim error.

reverifiedAgainst.tarballChecksumVerifiedAgainst: the channel's own sha256sum.txt, before use
reverifiedAgainst.apiFilesAtCommit: ed9ff0d: type_config.go, type_config_include.go and type_platform.go are byte-identical to the hashes above (fetched from github.com/openshift/oc-mirror at ed9ff0d)
reverifiedAgainst.method: 36 probe documents run through `oc-mirror --v2 -c <file> file://<dir> --dry-run` with an isolated HOME; verdicts are recorded per rule below and as fixtures in backend/test/fixtures/imageset-config/binary-probes.json.

strictDecodingEvidence: internal/pkg/config/load.go calls yaml.UnmarshalStrict and dec.DisallowUnknownFields(). Probing a deliberately bogus top-level key returns: json: unknown field "totallyBogusTopLevelField".

kubeVirtContainer.note: The OCP 4.22 documentation table lists this among the top-level entries. The binary rejects it there. Binary wins mechanically (runbook Rule 2.5); the documentation discrepancy is recorded, not silently resolved.

mirror.operators[].packages[].channels[].note: IncludeConfig is a Go type embedded with json:",inline", never a YAML key. It has never existed as a key in v1alpha1, v1alpha2 or v2alpha1. This was defect FQ-9.

mirror.operators[].targetName.note: Present in v1alpha2 and deprecated there in oc-mirror 4.13; removed entirely from v2alpha1.

mirror.helm.local[].charts.imagePaths.note: charts belongs to Repository, not to a local Chart. A local chart carries imagePaths directly.

mirror.platform.channels[].includeMin.note: No such field. Unlike targetName and includeConfig this is not even a v1 carry-over: it appears in neither v1alpha2 nor v2alpha1. The v2alpha1 ReleaseChannel carries exactly name, type, minVersion, maxVersion, shortestPath and full.

mirror.platform.channels[].includeMax.note: As includeMin. Never emitted by the generator, so catalog-only: no generated artifact was affected.

valueShapeRules.rule: array of OBJECTS each carrying name; an array of bare strings is rejected
valueShapeRules.error: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Mirror.ImageSetConfigurationSpec.mirror.blockedImages of type v2alpha1.BlockedImage
valueShapeRules.note: The OCP 4.22 documentation describes this as 'Array of strings'. The binary disagrees. Binary wins mechanically; discrepancy recorded.

semanticRules.rule: When mirror.platform.channels is non-empty and mirror.platform.architectures is absent, oc-mirror defaults architectures to [amd64].
semanticRules.binaryEvidence: With no architectures the binary requests .../graph?arch=amd64; with architectures [arm64] it requests arch=arm64.
semanticRules.consequence: Omitting architectures for a non-x86_64 target cluster mirrors the WRONG release payload while the configuration still parses cleanly. Architect must emit architectures whenever the Blueprint architecture is known.

semanticRules.rule: A package may filter by package-level minVersion/maxVersion OR by channel-level minVersion/maxVersion, never both.
semanticRules.error: mixing both filtering by minVersion/maxVersion and filtering by channel minVersion/maxVersion is not allowed

semanticRules.rule: Operator minVersion/maxVersion must parse as semantic versions. Partial versions such as 4.22 are coerced and accepted.
Duplicate catalog entries, duplicate package names within a catalog, duplicate channel names within a package, and duplicate release channel names are each rejected.

architectMapping._note: Blueprint target-cluster architecture -> mirror.platform.architectures value. Implemented by normalizeBlueprintArch in backend/src/generate.js, shared with install-config architecture.

apiVersion.binaryBehaviour: not checked: ReadConfig validates kind only; v1alpha2 and arbitrary strings decode (probes 02, 03, 27)

kind.binaryBehaviour: missing -> 'configuration missing `kind`'; other values -> 'cannot parse "X" as "ImageSetConfiguration"' (probes 04, 20b, 20c, 35)

archiveSize.binaryBehaviour: int64: strings and fractions are rejected (probes 06, 07); negative values are accepted (probe 29), so the minimum is Architect policy

mirror.binaryBehaviour: missing -> 'configuration missing the `mirror` stanza' (probe 05); empty or null -> 'no images to copy' at run time (probes 21, 22)

mirror.platform.architectures.binaryBehaviour: unknown values decode, then fail at collection with 'no release images found' (probe 19)

mirror.platform.channels[].name.binaryBehaviour: missing decodes, then fails at collection with 'no release images found' (probe 15)

mirror.platform.channels[].type.binaryBehaviour: PlatformType.UnmarshalJSON maps an unknown string to the zero value (ocp) silently (probe 09; type_platform.go)

mirror.operators[].catalog.binaryBehaviour: missing -> 'reference name is empty' (probe 11); unparseable -> 'unable to parse image correctly' (probe 28)

mirror.operators[].packages.binaryBehaviour: optional in practice: a catalog without packages reaches collection (probe 23)

mirror.operators[].packages[].name.binaryBehaviour: missing is not rejected before network collection (probe 24)

mirror.additionalImages.binaryBehaviour: an array of strings is rejected (probe 10)

mirror.additionalImages[].name.binaryBehaviour: empty -> 'reference name is empty'; no tag/digest -> 'unable to parse image correctly' (probes 16, 31)

mirror.blockedImages.binaryBehaviour: an array of strings is rejected (probe 18)

mirror.blockedImages[].name.note: a regular expression matched against image references, not an image reference

fieldTypes.string: JSON string (YAML scalars that are numbers or booleans are NOT strings: oc-mirror rejects `minVersion: 1.0`; quote it)
fieldTypes.integer: whole number within the int64 range

requiredness.binary: oc-mirror itself refuses the document without it
requiredness.architect: oc-mirror decodes the document but then fails later or silently loses intent; Architect refuses it up front

rules.binaryBehaviour: Documents after the first are silently ignored (probe 14: two documents, one image mirrored).

rules.rule: No two keys in one mapping that differ only in letter case.
rules.binaryBehaviour: Go's encoding/json matches field names case-insensitively and keeps the LAST value: probe 34 mirrored only the second list.

rules.rule: Keys use the documented spelling. A case variant below the top level (e.g. additionalimages) is read as the documented key and reported.
rules.binaryBehaviour: Accepted (probe 33). Top-level kind and mirror are matched exactly (probes 35, 36).

rules.rule: At most 20 aliases, and at most 20000 nodes after alias expansion.
rules.binaryBehaviour: Aliases are accepted (probe 13); the bound protects the importer from alias expansion bombs.

rules.rule: YAML 1.2 core types only: no !!binary, !!timestamp, !!set or custom tags.
rules.binaryBehaviour: !!binary decodes to bytes and then fails as an image reference (probe 32).

rules.rule: UTF-8 text without NUL or other control characters (a UTF-8 BOM is accepted and ignored); at most 1 MiB.
Only keys listed in fields are allowed.
Each value has the type listed in fields.
Fields marked required are present and non-empty; see requiredness.
Fields with enum or itemEnum take one of the listed values.
mirror has at least one of platform channels, operators, additionalImages, helm or samples.
Unique catalogs (by catalog, targetCatalog and targetTag), package names per catalog, channel names per package and release channel names.
A package filters by package-level OR channel-level minVersion/maxVersion, never both.
Operator minVersion/maxVersion parse as semantic versions (Masterminds semver: optional v, one to three numeric parts, optional pre-release and build).
Catalogs and additional images are image references with a tag or digest; catalogs may also use the oci:// transport.
No user:password@ credentials embedded in any URL or reference. Registry credentials belong in an auth file, never in the configuration.

findingAuthorities.binary: oc-mirror refuses the document when it loads it
findingAuthorities.binary-at-run: oc-mirror loads the document, then fails while collecting content
findingAuthorities.architect: oc-mirror would accept the document but silently lose or misread part of the user's intent, or the value is meaningless; Architect refuses it up front
findingAuthorities.mixed: see the field's requiredness or enum source
